name: Ilya Castellane
equipment: Hardshell plate, matt grey, Kessane marine pattern with the insignia burned off
Laser rifle, two-handed, with a folding stock (smuggled aboard the Moth, not the liner)
Vacuum suit rated for the shadow, with mag-boots
A Kessane Third Marine Company challenge coin with a hole drilled through it
features: Augmented: Dermal Plating (Enhanced: +1 AC; subdermal ceramic lattice across chest and forearms)
Combat Training: Marksman (+2 to ranged attack rolls)
Adrenaline (bonus action, regain 1d10+4 hit points, once per short rest)
Tactical Surge (one additional action, once per short rest)
Old Unit (Veteran feature: serving and former soldiers recognise her bearing and will share rumours, a bunk or a warning)

personality.traits: I check the exits, the cover and the hull class of every room I walk into, out loud, and people have stopped finding it funny. I am very calm and very polite right up until I am not.
personality.ideals: Nobody gets left in the dark. I have seen what Kessane does with people who are useful, and I will put myself between that and anyone.
personality.bonds: Pell Strake is aboard the Aubade in a Kessane suit. He carried me two kilometres on Iapetus. I do not know what I will do if he is on the other side of a door.
personality.flaws: I don't trust anything I can't shoot, and on this job that is most of the important things.

appearance: A tall, broad woman of thirty-eight with a shaved scalp, Kessane-standard gene-edited shoulders and the faint grey sheen of dermal plating at her collar and wrists. Her eyes are very pale and never quite still. She moves like someone carrying a rifle even when she isn't, and she sits with her back to a bulkhead, never a viewport.
backstory: Ilya Castellane signed with Kessane Armaments' private marine arm at nineteen. Kessane paid for the gene edits and the plating, which is how Kessane recruits. She did fourteen years: convoy guard, station boarding actions, and two very bad months on Iapetus that she doesn't discuss. She left after Kessane trialled a sun-diving gunship whose navigation intelligence, a licensed mind on a leash, flew a refinery crew into a flare to test its own limits. The crew had been told the ship was automated. So had she. She has worked freelance since, mostly convoy security out of Caloris High, and she took Oriel Mabb's job the moment she heard the buyer's name. She does not yet know what Lot Zero is. She has guessed that if Kessane wants it this badly, she doesn't want them to have it.
